title: Zero to Model: Train Your First Classifier
description: Hands-on beginner workshop. Bring a laptop; no coding or machine learning experience needed. You will train and evaluate a small image classifier in a free notebook environment.

title: Paper Reading Group: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
description: A plain-language walkthrough and discussion of one recent paper on retrieval-augmented generation. Open to non-members.

title: Applied ML Showcase
description: End-of-semester demo night where every project pod presents what it built. Open to the whole campus, with food provided.

title: Idea Gym: Find a Problem Worth Solving
description: Open brainstorming session for students without an idea or team. Short exercises on spotting problems and a round of two-minute pitches.

title: Co-Founder Mixer
description: Meet students from engineering, business, design and the arts who are looking for teammates. Structured introductions followed by open networking.

title: Demo Night
description: Cohort teams present ten weeks of work to students, alumni and invited guests. Free and open to everyone.

title: Finance Careers 101 Info Night
description: Introductory session on what the club does, how analyst training works and how to apply. No finance background needed.

title: Fall Stock Pitch Night
description: Sector teams pitch companies for the paper-traded portfolio to a panel of alumni judges. Open to observers.

title: Open Workshop Tour and Robot Demo
description: See the competition robot drive, meet the subteams and tour the workshop. Good first visit for anyone thinking of applying.

title: Rookie Rover Race Day
description: New members race the small rovers they built this semester on an obstacle course. Spectators welcome.

title: Autonomy Software Night: Intro to Path Planning
description: Introductory session on how the robot decides where to go. Open to non-members; some programming experience helpful.

title: Tiny Games Challenge
description: Make a complete tiny game in three hours, solo or in a pair. Beginners welcome; starter templates provided.

title: Workshop: Pixel Art from Zero
description: Learn the basics of pixel art and animate a four-frame character. No drawing experience needed.

title: Arcade Night
description: Public showcase of this semester's finished student games. Play, vote for your favorite and meet the teams.

title: Open Crit Night
description: A critique circle open to non-members. Bring any work in progress, or just listen. Beginner-only groups available.

title: Design Foundations: Typography Basics
description: Beginner workshop on choosing and pairing typefaces, hierarchy and spacing.

title: Design Careers Panel
description: Alumni working in UX, product and brand design talk about their paths and answer questions.

title: Chai Social and Game Night
description: Chai, snacks, carrom and card games. Everyone is welcome, members or not.

title: Bollywood Dance Workshop for Beginners
description: Learn a short routine step by step. No dance experience needed; wear comfortable clothes.

title: Winter Lights Dinner
description: A community dinner with music and student performances to close the semester. Tickets cover dinner; member discount applies.

title: Open Voices Workshop
description: Free vocal workshop for any student: warm-ups, blending in small groups and a simple three-part arrangement. No audition.

title: Fall Concert: Lights Down
description: The group's full fall concert of original a cappella arrangements. Free admission.

title: Volunteer Information Session
description: Learn how weekly tutoring works, what training involves and how to sign up for next semester's sessions.

title: Book and School-Supply Drive Sorting Day
description: Help sort and pack donated books and supplies for partner schools. Open to anyone, no training needed.

title: Saturday Garden Work Session
description: Planting, weeding and compost turning at the campus garden plot. Tools and gloves provided; drop in any time.
location: Campus Garden Plot, behind the Science Library

title: Repair Cafe
description: Bring clothes, bikes or small electronics and learn to fix them with volunteer help. Free.

title: Fall Harvest Dinner
description: A shared dinner cooked from the garden plot's harvest, with short updates from each project team.

title: Beginner Sunrise Hike
description: An easy-graded 4-mile hike with a slow pace and plenty of breaks. Carpools leave from campus; gear closet boots available.
location: Meet at the Campus Center main entrance

title: Indoor Climbing Night
description: Weekly climbing session with a beginner belay lesson at the start. Rental shoes included in the club rate.
location: Meet at the Recreation Center lobby

title: Desert Stargazing Campout
description: One-night beginner-friendly campout with a night-sky walk. Tents and sleeping bags can be borrowed from the gear closet.
location: Carpools depart from Parking Structure B

title: Health Careers Night
description: Panel with people from six health professions, including nursing, medicine, pharmacy and public health, followed by small-group questions.

title: Workshop: Planning Your Prerequisites
description: Peer-led session on planning prerequisite courses across different health career paths. Bring your questions.

title: Finals Wellness Evening
description: Low-key evening on managing stress during finals, with snacks and study-group sign-ups.
